The caution is appropriate, the leaning is inconclusive, and the next steps are concrete. But several claims are unsupported or inconsistent, and some references do not fit their sentences. The investigator would have to recheck parts of the analysis.","problems":["'Within every complexity stratum ... two to four times the all-provider share' is overstated: the 0-condition stratum has 0 share, and the 5+ stratum is about 2.4x. The 1-condition stratum is about 3.4x and the 2-condition stratum about 4x.","The 'roughly two to four times' stratum claim is not computed or shown as a figure; it is an approximate reading from the table.","The unmatched figures 10 (late and data 10%) and 16 (time entries repeat in about 16% of notes) are not on the evidence card. The repeated-time claim may come from tool output, but it is not verifiable here.","'Documented 99215s are unsupported at close to the peer rate' is confusing wording. The 5% vs 3% comparison is not 'close' with n=19, and 'unsupported' misstates 'documented below billed'.","C0057752 and C0058040 are cited as data-flagged notes, but C0057752 appears on the card only as a supported high-MDM example, and C0058040 does not appear on the card at all. Neither claim is in cited_claim_ids, so the data-flag claim is not verifiable.","Example claims C0057861 and C0058186 are described as 'sampled exceptions', but the summary gives little context. 'Late' notes and 'unsigned' are mentioned without explanation.","The headline says the 'returned charts mostly support the billed levels', which is reasonable but rests on only 4% of claims; the summary does acknowledge this limitation.","The rationale is long and mixes conclusions in both directions (it says the sicker panel does not explain the excess, then the charts support the billed levels), which makes the leaning harder to follow."]}
